title: A seeded script that reads a set of strings
proves: sorted(...) over a set and a membership test replay identically under rngSeed
Build replays every seeded model under three other hash seeds and rejects a set order that changes the rows
a two-element set, a key= tie, a dict-view difference and a set kept in a variable are each rejected
the replay is a check, not a proof: a set whose order agrees under all four hash seeds stays hidden
